# Kongtrol

> Kongtrol (formerly VPN Kongtrol; CLI binary: `kongtrol`) is an open-source
> multi-VPN orchestrator for Windows, Linux and macOS. It runs several VPN tunnels at the
> same time and decides, per destination, which tunnel each connection leaves through.

It is not a VPN client and not a VPN provider: it orchestrates the VPN clients you already
have installed (NordVPN, Proton VPN, Surfshark, FortiClient, WireGuard, OpenVPN, Tailscale,
Cloudflare WARP, Cisco AnyConnect, GlobalProtect — 10 in total), with policy-based routing,
an OS-level kill switch, a DNS guard, an auto-reconnect watchdog and a web dashboard.

Attach mode: you connect as usual in your VPN app (NordVPN, Proton VPN, Surfshark,
FortiClient); Kongtrol detects the tunnel and takes over status, auto-reconnect, DNS and
routing rules. It runs in the background with a tray icon and a web panel; the CLI has full
parity for automation. A privileged helper (`kongtrol service install`) needs one
administrator prompt at install time.

- License: Apache License 2.0
- Language: Go 1.27+
- Platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS
- Website: https://kongtrol.app/ (Spanish) · https://kongtrol.app/en/ (English)
- Source: https://github.com/DerotLuna/vpn-kongtrol
- Latest release: https://github.com/DerotLuna/vpn-kongtrol/releases/latest

- [Privacy policy](https://kongtrol.app/en/privacy): what stays local, which connections Kongtrol makes on its own (public-IP check via api.ipify.org), no telemetry
- [Security policy](https://kongtrol.app/en/security): private vulnerability reporting and disclosure timelines
- [Terms](https://kongtrol.app/en/terms): Apache-2.0, no warranty, beta
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/DerotLuna/vpn-kongtrol/blob/main/docs/CLI.md): every `kongtrol` subcommand and flag
- [Configuration](https://github.com/DerotLuna/vpn-kongtrol/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md): full `kongtrol.yaml` reference
- [Security architecture](https://github.com/DerotLuna/vpn-kongtrol/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): network connections Kongtrol makes, privileged helper and leases, kill switch, DNS guard, recovery procedures

## Common commands

```
kongtrol init                 # interactive wizard: detects installed VPN clients, stores credentials in the OS keychain
kongtrol up office aws        # connect one or more profiles
kongtrol status               # tunnel states
kongtrol map <domain|ip>      # show which tunnel a destination resolves to
kongtrol doctor               # validate the whole stack before connecting
kongtrol dashboard            # open the web UI at localhost:9741
```

## Notes

- Credentials live in the OS keychain, never in `kongtrol.yaml`.
- The dashboard is embedded in the binary with `//go:embed`; it needs no external server.
- The binary is unsigned: antivirus and SmartScreen false positives are documented in the security guide.
